title: Uncapped Banners
description: Mod that removes banner layer limitations from 6 to 16 layer
body:
The mod must be put on both the server and client for it to work.

There was no mod for banner limit increasing so i made one, if something breaks or contact me on discord: supershort
I belive the mod should work with most banner mod that dont try to change the layer limit/influence the layer system.
